p.span: 1. General:
1.1 All prices listed are in Australian Dollars (AUD) and are exclusive of GST, unless otherwise stated.
1.2 Prices are subject to change without notice. The applicable price will be the price in effect at the time of order confirmation.
1.3 This pricelist is confidential and intended for use by approved trade customers only.
2. Orders:
2.1 All orders must be submitted in writing (email or approved ordering system).
2.2 Orders are subject to acceptance by DPG Systems.
2.3 Once an order has been confirmed, cancellations or changes may not be accepted, or may incur costs.
3. Custom & Imported Products:
3.1 Custom, made-to-order, or imported products cannot be cancelled or returned once ordered.
3.2 Lead times provided are estimates only and may vary due to manufacturing, shipping, or supply chain conditions.
3.3 DPG Systems is not liable for delays outside its reasonable control.
4. Pricing Validity:
4.1 Prices are valid for 30 days from issue of the pricelist unless otherwise stated.
4.2 DPG Systems reserves the right to revise pricing due to changes in raw materials, freight, exchange rates, or supplier pricing.
5. Payment Terms:
5.1 Standard payment terms are 30 days EOM from invoice, subject to credit approval.
5.2 DPG Systems reserves the right to request payment in advance or a deposit for new customers, large orders, or imported products.
5.3 Overdue accounts may result in order holds and may incur interest or recovery costs.
6. Delivery, Fees & Risk:
6.1 Delivery charges are included in standard pricing.
6.2 Order Processing and Handling fee of $35 + GST applies to all orders under $300 + GST.
6.3 Risk for the goods passes to the customer upon delivery.
6.4 Customers must inspect goods upon delivery and notify DPG Systems of any damage or shortages within 48 hours.
7. Returns & Claims:
7.1 Returns will only be accepted with prior written approval.
7.2 Stock items approved for return will incur a restocking fee of 20%, providing it is returned in original condition and packaging.
7.3 Custom, modified, or imported products are non-returnable unless faulty.
8. Warranty – 12 Months:
8.1 Products are warranted against defects in materials and workmanship for a period of 12 months from the date of supply.
8.2 This warranty covers repair or replacement of the defective product at DPG Systems’ discretion.
8.3 The warranty does not cover:
8.3.1 Normal wear and tear.
8.3.2 Incorrect installation.
8.3.3 Misuse, abuse, or modification.
8.3.4 Damage caused by improper maintenance or environmental conditions.
8.4 Labour, removal, reinstallation, and consequential costs are excluded unless agreed in writing.
9. Limitation of Liability:
9.1 To the maximum extent permitted by law, DPG Systems’ liability is limited to the supply, repair, or replacement of the goods.
9.2 DPG Systems is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses.
10. Compliance with Australian Consumer Law:
10.1 Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts, or modifies any rights under the Australian Consumer Law that cannot be excluded.
11. Governing Law:
11.1 These terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia.
